title: Accumulate gradients through a scalar graph
description: A quick reference for the scalar reverse-mode and graph-accumulation terms used here.

terms.definition: A directed record of scalar values, operations, and their dependencies.
Differentiation that propagates one output sensitivity backward toward many inputs.
The selected output's derivative with respect to one intermediate value.
One recorded occurrence of a value consumed by an operation.
An operation result's derivative with respect to one operand occurrence.
An ordering that visits consumers before sending completed sensitivities to operands.
Adding contributions from every path instead of overwriting earlier contributions.
One complete reverse traversal seeded from a selected scalar output.
Creating an untracked value that preserves its primal but stops gradients.
Clearing stored parameter gradients before accumulating a new training step.
